title: Written Expression — Preposition & Collective Noun Fix
prompt:
Perbaiki kesalahan grammar pada kalimat berikut dengan mengetik ulang kalimat yang benar secara utuh:
"Despite of the heavy rain, the archaeological team were able to completing the excavation on time."
correct_answer: Despite the heavy rain, the archaeological team was able to complete the excavation on time.
explanation: Hapus 'of' setelah 'Despite', gunakan 'was' untuk collective noun tunggal, dan 'to complete' (to-infinitive).

title: Sentence Transformation — Correlative Inversion
prompt:
Tulis ulang kalimat berikut agar diawali dengan struktur inversi 'Not only...':
"Solar energy reduces carbon emissions, and it also lowers long-term electricity costs for households."
correct_answer: Not only does solar energy reduce carbon emissions, but it also lowers long-term electricity costs for households.
explanation: Setelah 'Not only' di awal kalimat, gunakan auxiliary 'does' + subject 'solar energy' + bare infinitive 'reduce'.
